text: ZX81 WEATHER WALL 07 NOV 12:08Z. ALERT: COASTAL FLOOD WARNING IN ISRAEL; EXTREME HEAT WARNING IN AUSTRALIA; WINTER STORM WARNING IN RUSSIA, NUNAVUT; HIGH WIND WARNING IN RUSSIA, SPAIN, PORTUGAL; HEAVY RAIN WARNING IN SPAIN, SAUDI ARABIA, MADAGASCAR, PORTUGAL, ISRAEL; SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING IN ECUADOR, PARAGUAY; 1 MAJOR FIRE MACEIRA; HOT NIGHT 28C LAGOS, 26C MANILA, 26C ABIDJAN, 25C MUMBAI, 25C TARAWA; TROPICAL NIGHT 22C SANTO DOMING, 20C BENGALURU, 20C CARACAS; DROUGHT EMERGENCY EUROPE, W AFRICA -GDACS. HIGH 34C MUMBAI, LOW 1C MOSCOW. THUNDER IN SAO PAULO. 100 ZX81S ON WATCH.

image.alt: A 10x10 wall of 100 ZX81 screens rendering a live world weather map in 1-bit block graphics. Alerts: coastal flood warning ISRAEL; extreme heat warning AUSTRALIA; winter storm warning RUSSIA, NUNAVUT; high wind warning RUSSIA, SPAIN, PORTUGAL; heavy rain warning SPAIN, SAUDI ARABIA, MADAGASCAR, PORTUGAL, ISRAEL; severe thunderstorm warning ECUADOR, PARAGUAY; sweltering night W AFRICA 28C, TROP ATL 26C, SE ASIA 26C, N INDIA 25C, W PACIFIC 25C; 1 major fire: MACEIRA; hot night N ATLANTIC 22C, CARIBBEAN 20C, S INDIA 20C; drought emergency EUROPE, W AFRICA (GDACS). Hottest 34C at MUMBAI, coldest 1C at MOSCOW. Precipitation: rain areas and snow or wintry areas. Roughest seas at N PACIFIC. Notable: smoky, unhealthy air over N INDIA. 7 further wildfires burning.
